items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: The story of George Shearing, when he was working at Birdland

ctx.x: January 6th, and I'm forcing you to let me turn on the tape recorder because you're about to tell me a story.

Yes. Well, I just finished telling one, but I'll tell it again. The story of George Shearing, when he was working at Birdland, and somebody was playing a joke on him, and you must realize he's blind and that he came upstairs and got in the back seat of the car, but he didn't realize Al Hibbler, who is blind too, was the driver. And Al had learned where the starter was, and George was saying, "Where are we going," and somebody happened to reach in the window and tell him, "You know, that's Al Hibbler driving," and…
